title: Pin the guard job's env wiring, and make the suite print its own interpreter
description: Two peer findings. lore-cli (PR #119): deleting the workflow fetch line survived its suite at 0 red until a WIRING assertion pinned it - the script-level test exercises the diagnosis, a different site from the wiring. Applied here: our wiring test pins the run: line and fetch-depth: 0 but NOT the env block. Measured, not reasoned: BEFORE_SHA miswired to github.sha exits 0 GREEN with main unchanged at <sha> - a permanently always-green gate; deleting the env block exits 1 loudly. Only the silent one matters and nothing catches it. opum-doc (ODOC-216): fixed our shared bash-version claim FORWARD by having the suite print environment: bash VERSION, git VERSION above its verdict - cheaper than making the CI job print it, and it covers local runs where the same claim gets made.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The wiring test pins BEFORE_SHA to github.event.before and FORCED to github.event.forced; miswiring either in the workflow turns the suite red
The suite prints its own bash and git versions above the verdict, so local and CI runs each name their interpreter instead of a reader trusting a written claim
All five existing mutants still die after the change, re-run AFTER the fix per OMARK-59, plus the two new env mutants
